title: Replace a commercial mooring licence
summary: You can order a replacement for a lost, damaged, or destroyed commercial mooring licence certificate at a Service NSW Centre or by post.
intro: If your commercial mooring licence certificate is lost, damaged or destroyed, you can order a replacement at a Service NSW Centre, or by post.
what_you_need: The PDF form: Application for Maritime Replacement Products

how_to_steps.text: Make sure that you have all the required documents.
Visit a service centre and submit your application in person, or post it using the details on the form.

external_links.text: Boating and marine in NSW – Transport for NSW

faqs.q: How can I get a replacement commercial mooring licence?
faqs.a: You can order a replacement licence certificate if your original is lost, damaged, or destroyed. You can do this at a Service NSW Centre or by post.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to replace my licence?
faqs.a: You need the 'Application for Maritime Replacement Products' form, proof of identity, and payment for the fee.
